title: Frame To Samples
text: Convert frame-based data to sample stream, 1 input, 2 outputs; {Idle cycles between samples} sets the number of idle cycles to insert after each, {Idle cycles between frames} sets the number of idle cycles to insert at the end of each, {Output size} sets the number of values representing each sample and {Compose output from interleaved input samples} sets the order of output samples relative to input. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: frame
ports.summary: Frame of input samples column vector

ports.name: ctrl
ports.summary: Control signals accompanying sample stream samplecontrol bus

params.name: Idle cycles between samples
params.values: Number of idle cycles to insert after each sample 0 (default) | integer

params.name: Idle cycles between frames
params.values: Number of idle cycles to insert at the end of each frame 0 (default) | integer

params.name: Output size
params.values: Number of values representing each sample 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Compose output from interleaved input samples
params.values: Order of output samples relative to input order off (default) | on
